objective_for_doctor: Assess and diagnose the patient presenting with changes in behavior and memory over the past few months.

turns.doctor_opening: Hello, what brings you in today? Could you tell me about yourself and what's been going on?
turns.patient_opening: “Lately, my behavior hasn’t been like it used to be—sometimes I laugh at inappropriate times or say things I shouldn’t, and occasionally I’ve grabbed at people without meaning to. I’ve also been having more trouble with my memory and taking care of myself, and I get stuck finding the right words in conversation.”

turns.doctor_question: I understand. To help me get a better picture of your current health, have you noticed any changes in your eyesight, such as blurriness, dark spots, or any loss of vision?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t noticed any blurriness, dark spots, or changes in my vision. I’ve been having the main issues with my behavior, memory getting worse, and trouble finding words, but my eyesight seems the same.”

turns.doctor_question: To help me get a better picture of your overall health, could you tell me if you currently smoke or have a history of smoking?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I don’t smoke and I’ve never really had a smoking history. I only drink alcohol socially, but nothing excessive.”

turns.doctor_question: I understand. To help me get a better picture of how you're feeling, have you been experiencing any nausea or feeling sick to your stomach lately?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t had nausea or an upset stomach—I generally feel physically okay. It’s mostly been the behavior changes, worsening memory, and difficulty finding the right words.”
